title: Pin the .NET 10 SDK version properly, using global.json

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The current revision pins SDK 10.0.403 in `global.json` with roll-forward disabled, aligns the runtime package to 10.0.14, and routes the default pipeline installer through that JSON pin. Explicit channel callers still select their channel. The release pool selection now distinguishes the Visual Studio 2026 stable and preview images.

The additional provisioning delta was assessed separately: a protected startup acknowledgement is distinct from readiness, the 90-second startup and subsequent non-renewable 300-second preparation budgets remain bounded, and the complete provisioning marker is still required. Public progress diagnostics admit only known phase names and bounded numeric timings, not raw diagnostic text.

**Validation scope:** All seven changed PowerShell files parsed. The two affected Sandbox/provisioning Pester suites passed 211 checks on this exact revision, including deadline/identity cases and existing preparation contracts. These are fixture/source checks, not a real privileged provisioning run. No Azure template expansion, SDK installation on the build agents, full product build or VM/Sandbox execution was performed.

No additional correction is requested by this focused accumulated assessment. The unexecuted pipeline and runtime paths remain unverified; this is not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
